title: Neutrogena Healthy Scalp Clarify & Shine Shampoo with Pink Grapefruit, 12 Fl Oz, Pack of 3
description:
About This Item

Introducing the Neutrogena Exfoliating Healthy Scalp Clarify & Shine Shampoo for Oily Hair and Scalp. We understand the challenges of dealing with oily hair and scalp, and that's why we've formulated this shampoo specifically to address those concerns. Our Neutrogena shampoo is packed with the power of pink grapefruit, known for its clarifying properties.

This refreshing ingredient helps remove excess oil and residue, leaving your hair feeling clean and refreshed. With its gentle exfoliating action, it helps to unclog pores and promote a healthier scalp. Not only does this shampoo effectively clarify and cleanse, but it also helps to restore shine to your hair. The pH-balanced formula ensures that your hair and scalp are taken care of without causing any irritation.

We understand the importance of using safe and gentle products on your hair, which is why this shampoo is paraben and phthalate-free. It is also color-safe, so you can enjoy the benefits regardless of whether you have color-treated hair or not. With its 12oz size, you'll have plenty of product to last you for a while. Simply work it into a lather, massage it into your scalp, and rinse thoroughly for best results.

Combine it with our Neutrogena conditioner for a complete hair care routine. Treat your oily hair and scalp to the clarifying power of Neutrogena. Shop now and experience the difference for yourself.
